licensing_agencies.name: NYS Office of Children and Family Services (OCFS), Division of Child Care Services
licensing_agencies.scope: Statewide licensing/registration of day care centers, school-age, family and group family day care. Excludes NYC day care centers.

licensing_agencies.name: NYC Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (DOHMH), Bureau of Child Care
licensing_agencies.scope: Permits group child care (Health Code Article 47) and school-based child care (Article 43) in the five boroughs.

top_operators.name: Yeled V'yalda Early Childhood Center INC
All My Children Day Care and Nursery School
The Friends of Crown Heights Educational Centers,INC

top_violation_types.title: NYC Health Code §47.41(j)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: At time of inspection floors/walls ceilings were observed Not maintained; in disrepair or covered in a toxic finish.

top_violation_types.title: NYC Health Code §47.33(c)(1)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Staff and volunteers obtain documentation showing immunization with 2 doses measles/mumps, 1 dose rubella, 2 doses varicella and 1 dose Tdap. Medical exemptions only. History of measles, mumps or rubella shall Not replace MMR vaccine except in presence of MMR varicella antibodies.

top_violation_types.title: NYC Health Code §47.33(b)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: At time of inspection it was determined that child care service allows staff to perform their duties that are Not healthy or are incapable of carrying out their duties. Staff medical clearances are Not maintained by child care service.

top_violation_types.title: NYC Health Code §47.37(b)(1)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: At time of inspection it was determined that child care service failed to ensure staff received required training within time frames and/or failed to maintain training records.

top_violation_types.title: NYC Health Code §47.49(a)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: At time of inspection child care service facility observed Not maintained or in disrepair. Dry sweeping observed in areas occupied by children.

top_violation_types.title: NYC Health Code §47.59(a)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Exits and other egress Not provided with required signage at time of inspection.

top_violation_types.title: NYC Health Code §47.37(b)(4)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Training in SIDS, Shaken Baby Syndrome and Safe Sleep practices Not provided to staff

top_violation_types.title: NYC Health Code §47.59(b)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Fire extinguishers observed Not to be inspected or maintained at time of inspection.

top_violation_types.title: NYC Health Code §43.11(b)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: School-based child care staff observed caring for children while unhealthy. Staff medical certificate of fitness Not provided.

top_violation_types.title: NYC Health Code §131.09(f)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Walls and ceiling in commercial building Not properly constructed; Not maintained in good repair; unclean

top_violation_types.title: NYC Health Code §47.19(c)(1)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Fingerprint screening Not arranged for current and prospective personnel; Results Not satisfactory or CAP was Not approved

top_violation_types.title: NYC Health Code §47.25(a)(2)(B)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Enrolled children 6 months to 59 months have Not received FDA approved annual influenza immunization by December 31 of the year
